# Supadata: Web media to text API for makers

Supadata is a comprehensive API designed for makers to extract public web content. Get structured data from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X (Twitter) for your next project.

## General Information

- [supadata](https://supadata.ai/): The main page for Supadata, providing an overview of the API's capabilities.
- [Playground](https://supadata.ai/playground): An interactive environment to test and experiment with the API's features.
- [Documentation](https://docs.supadata.ai/): Detailed technical documentation outlining the API's functionalities and usage.
- [Pricing](https://supadata.ai/pricing): Information regarding the cost structure for using the Supadata API.
- [Sign in](https://dash.supadata.ai/): Portal for users to log into their Supadata accounts.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://docs.supadata.ai/getting-started): A guide for new users to begin using the Supadata API effectively.

## Integrations

- [MCP](https://github.com/supadata-ai/mcp): Connect Supadata to AI assistants and IDEs like Claude and Cursor.
- [Make](https://supadata.ai/nocode#make): Information on integrating Supadata with the Make platform.
- [Zapier](https://supadata.ai/nocode#zapier): Details on using Supadata with Zapier for automation.
- [n8n](https://supadata.ai/nocode#n8n): Integration options for using Supadata with n8n.
- [Active Pieces](https://supadata.ai/nocode#active-pieces): Information on connecting Supadata with Active Pieces for workflow automation.
- [JS SDK](https://github.com/supadata-ai/js): Official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for integrating Supadata into Node.js and browser projects.
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/supadata-ai/py): Official Python SDK for seamless Supadata API integration in Python apps and scripts.

## API Features

### Universal Services

- [Transcript](https://docs.supadata.ai/get-transcript): Access to transcriptions of audio and video content on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X (Twitter).
- [Metadata](https://docs.supadata.ai/get-metadata): Get metadata (eg. title, author, statistics) from media on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X (Twitter).

### Web Scraping

- [Scrape](https://docs.supadata.ai/web/scrape): Methods for scraping web content using the API.
- [Map](https://docs.supadata.ai/web/map): Mapping functionalities available within the API.
- [Crawl](https://docs.supadata.ai/web/crawl): Options for crawling web pages for content extraction.

### YouTube

- [Channel](https://docs.supadata.ai/youtube/channel): Access to YouTube channel data.
- [Playlist](https://docs.supadata.ai/youtube/playlist): Information on retrieving playlists from YouTube.
- [Channel Videos](https://docs.supadata.ai/youtube/channel-videos): Details on accessing videos from a specific YouTube channel.
- [Playlist Videos](https://docs.supadata.ai/youtube/playlist-videos): Information on retrieving videos from a specific playlist.
- [Batch](https://docs.supadata.ai/youtube/batch): Functionality for processing multiple requests in a single batch.

### URL and Language Support

- [URL Formats](https://docs.supadata.ai/youtube/supported-url-formats): Guidelines on the acceptable URL formats for API requests.
- [Languages](https://docs.supadata.ai/youtube/supported-language-codes): Supported languages for content retrieval and transcription.

## Error Handling

- [Invalid Request](https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/invalid-request): Error response for malformed API requests.
- [Unauthorized](https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/unauthorized): Response indicating lack of proper authentication.
- [Not Found](https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/not-found): Error message for requests that do not match any resources.
- [Limit Exceeded](https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/limit-exceeded): Notification when usage limits have been surpassed.
- [Upgrade Required](https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/upgrade-required): Message indicating that a higher subscription tier is needed.
- [Transcript Unavailable](https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/transcript-unavailable): Error indicating that a requested transcript is not available.
- [Internal Error](https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/internal-error): General error message for unexpected server issues.

## Specialized APIs

- [YouTube Transcript API](https://supadata.ai/youtube-transcript-api): API specifically for retrieving transcripts from YouTube videos.
- [TikTok Transcript API](https://supadata.ai/tiktok-transcript-api): API for accessing transcripts from TikTok content.
- [Instagram Transcript API](https://supadata.ai/instagram-transcript-api): API for retrieving transcripts from Instagram videos.
- [X (Twitter) Transcript API](https://supadata.ai/twitter-transcript-api): API for accessing transcripts from X (formerly Twitter) content.
- [Whisper V3 Turbo API](https://supadata.ai/video-transcript-api): Advanced API for high-performance transcription services.
- [RapidAPI (YouTube)](https://rapidapi.com/8v2FWW4H6AmKw89/api/youtube-transcripts): Get YouTube transcripts through RapidAPI.
- [RapidAPI (Web)](https://rapidapi.com/8v2FWW4H6AmKw89/api/ai-content-scraper): Access to web scraping functionalities via RapidAPI.
